description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for verifying the functionality of git mail-related utilities like mailsplit and mailinfo. It performs various tests on email message parsing, splitting, and header processing, including handling of special encodings, headers, and edge cases.

methods.name: check_mailinfo
methods.description: Function to verify the output of git mailinfo against expected data for a given email sample.

methods.name: check_quoted_cr_mail
methods.description: Function to verify quoted CR-LF handling in quoted email samples.
